# payee-lock

> Pre-send guard for irreversible payments (wire, RTP, FedNow, book, stablecoin). Detects changed payee details and enforces a call-back to a contact on file before the change, a cooling-off period and dual approval, with a hash-chained audit log. Engineering checklist, not legal advice.

The guard returns allow, hold or block with coded findings (PL-CALLBACK-SUPPLIED-CONTACT, PL-LOOKALIKE-SENDER, PL-COOLING-OFF, PL-DUAL-APPROVAL and others). It validates ABA routing numbers, IBANs and EIP-55 wallet addresses. Standard library only. Background: FBI IC3 2025 report, BEC losses $3,046,598,558 across 24,768 complaints.

Built and maintained by Art Akopian, CEO of Banrox (https://banrox.com).

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/BanroxArt/payee-lock/blob/main/SKILL.md): Agent skill for checking a payment with this package.
- [examples/policy.toml](https://github.com/BanroxArt/payee-lock/blob/main/examples/policy.toml): Every policy key with its default.

## Source

- [guard.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/payee-lock/blob/main/src/payeelock/guard.py): The check and its findings.
- [instruments.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/payee-lock/blob/main/src/payeelock/instruments.py): Parsing, check digits, fingerprints.
- [policy.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/payee-lock/blob/main/src/payeelock/policy.py): Policy file schema.
- [audit.py](https://github.com/BanroxArt/payee-lock/blob/main/src/payeelock/audit.py): Hash-chained log.
